steps: Create your GigSmart worker profile and verify your ID.
Browse and accept posted shift gigs (pay shown on each offer).
Complete the shift and confirm your timesheet within 6 hours.
Wait for requester approval (up to 3 business days); funds land in your Worker Wallet.
Initiate a Rapid Transfer (3%, $0.50 min) for immediate payout to your bank.
timing: Requester approves timesheet (up to 3 business days); then Rapid Transfer pays immediately (3%, $0.50 min). Free standard transfer: up to 5 business days.
who_pays: The requester who posted the shift pays you through GigSmart — occupational accident insurance is covered at no cost to you.
who_qualifies: 18+; a profile plus ID verification; a background check for some shifts; a one-time financial verification (under an hour) before you can use Rapid Transfer.
work_available: An open marketplace of posted shifts you claim in the app; supply depends on requester demand in your market.
what_gets_accepted: The requester must approve your timesheet — they get up to 3 full business days to do it, and same-day pay only starts after approval.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees to join. Unpaid time: waiting up to 3 business days for timesheet approval (the same-day clock only starts after approval). Rapid Transfer costs 3% ($0.50 minimum); the free standard transfer takes up to 5 business days.
when_cash_arrives: After the requester approves your timesheet (up to 3 business days): Rapid Transfer pays immediately for 3% ($0.50 min); the free standard transfer takes up to 5 business days.

repeatable.cadence: New gigs post on the marketplace — complete a gig, get your timesheet approved, get paid, and claim the next one.
